name: web-tukuoma-real-estate-hero-with-skewed-photo-cards-and-circular-badge
title: TukuOma real estate hero with skewed interior photo cards, a rotating text badge and blue accents
whatItIs: A white hero with dashed column guides, 'Find your next perfect place to live.' in bold black, a blue 'Learn More' button and 'Find near me' pin link, a cluster of three skewed rounded interior photos with a circular 'Amazing Real Estate' text badge, small yellow and blue shapes and a testimonial with avatar.
whatItMeans: Friendly and modern; skewed cards and small shapes add playful movement to property search.
techniques: Skew overlapping photo cards for dynamism.
Add a circular text badge at a card corner.
Show faint column guides as a design detail.
Include a testimonial in the hero.

vocabulary.definition: Slanting a shape along one axis.
